verses.1: For the leader. A psalm of the Korahites.
verses.2: You once favored, LORD, your land, restored the good fortune of Jacob.
verses.3: You forgave the guilt of your people, pardoned all their sins. Selah
verses.4: You withdrew all your wrath, turned back your burning anger.
verses.5: Restore us once more, God our savior; abandon your wrath against us.
verses.6: Will you be angry with us forever, drag out your anger for all generations?
verses.7: Please give us life again, that your people may rejoice in you.
verses.8: Show us, LORD, your love; grant us your salvation.
verses.9: I will listen for the word of God; surely the LORD will proclaim peace To his people, to the faithful, to those who trust in him.
verses.10: Near indeed is salvation for the loyal; prosperity will fill our land.
verses.11: Love and truth will meet; justice and peace will kiss.
verses.12: Truth will spring from the earth; justice will look down from heaven.
verses.13: The LORD will surely grant abundance; our land will yield its increase.
verses.14: Prosperity will march before the Lord, and good fortune will follow behind.

notes.text: The prophet listens to God's revelation. Cf Hebrews 2:1.
Divine activity is personified as pairs of virtues.
